airzone_gateways.title: Airzone gateways
airzone_gateways.help: Connections saved in Moli, including paused gateways.
airzone_gateways.edit_help: Check the new settings before saving them. Moli must find the same gateway.
airzone_gateways.save_read_only: Saving enables read-only mode. No commands are sent to equipment.
airzone_gateways.stable_id: This identifier is retained to preserve links to existing devices. Different hardware must be added under a new identifier.
airzone_gateways.update_help: Moli checks the identity again, then restarts the connection in read-only mode. Names and history for this gateway are preserved.
airzone_gateways.paused_help: Withdrawn from Moli polling without deleting names or history. This status does not indicate a hardware fault.
airzone_gateways.running_help: The driver has started. Zone availability shows whether the gateway responds.
airzone_gateways.withdraw_help: Moli stops polling it. No physical equipment is deleted or commanded. Names and history are preserved, and the connection can be resumed.
airzone_gateways.replace_help: First, withdraw this connection from polling. Then add the new gateway with its own identifier. Existing devices are not transferred automatically.
airzone_gateways.withdrawn: “{instance}” is paused. You can check and resume it from this list.
airzone_gateways.uncertain: The withdrawal response was not received. Check the outcome for the same connection; no other gateway will be changed.
airzone_gateways.replacement_help: “{instance}” remains paused with its names and history. Add the new hardware under a different identifier; no history or automation is transferred automatically.
airzone_gateways.read_only_summary: Moli observes this gateway without commanding its equipment.
airzone_gateways.control_summary: Moli commands are allowed for the equipment on this gateway.
airzone_gateways.resume_before_control: Resume the connection before allowing control.
airzone_gateways.control_help: Commands and automations already approved in Moli will be able to operate all equipment on this gateway, according to its available capabilities.
airzone_gateways.control_scope: Other gateways keep their mode. You can return to read-only at any time. This confirmation does not itself send a heating command.
airzone_gateways.read_only_help: Moli will block new commands to this gateway. Equipment will continue with its current Airzone settings and schedules; this button does not turn it off.
airzone_gateways.mode_uncertain: The response was not received. Check the saved mode before granting control again.
airzone_gateways.controls_location: Available controls are in Rooms and Workshop. The Airzone view remains an observation view.
airzone_gateways.control_pin: Your Moli code allows commands to all equipment on this gateway. Other gateways do not change.
airzone_gateways.read_only_pin: Your Moli code confirms the return to read-only for this gateway. Its equipment will not be turned off.
airzone_gateways.existing_control_kept: This gateway was already saved. Its control permission is preserved.
airzone_gateways.configuration_disabled: This connection is disabled in the Moli configuration file. Re-enabling it must be authorized in that file.
airzone_gateways.configuration_read_only: Read-only mode is enforced by the Moli configuration file. Control cannot be authorized here.
